# UNCANNY

Public project page for UNCANNY, a closed-source real-time remastering project for Windows games and emulators.

Stable: v0.20.0-alpha.2 Final Alpha.
Development preview: UNCANNY Engine 5 — STRATA, checkpoint cad2556.

Main systems:
- STRATA real-time graphics/reconstruction engine
- REVENANT asset capture/reconstruction/replacement
- optional provider-backed neural rendering bridge
- launcher, Control Deck, repair/restore tooling

Current public docs should not be used to infer unsupported API/GPU/game claims. See docs/COMPATIBILITY.md and docs/STRATA-PREVIEW.md.
